title: Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes and Mozzarella
author: Lorenzo
description: Cherry tomatoes cooked just until they burst, with mozzarella melting into the hot pasta.
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic, add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt and cook for 8–10 minutes, until they soften.
Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Toss the pasta with the tomatoes off the heat, then add the mozzarella and torn basil and serve at once.
